# IDX — Mint scanner over the matrix, then every color looked up (wallet-free)

<!-- Generated by deployments/tools/prepare-cases.ts --network preview from the examples' metadata.json and the vectors; do not edit. -->

**Demonstrates**: MIP "Lookup": from a start height, every native mint of C02–C05 is found once with its (contract, domainSep, kind), and each color resolves to its identity and current metadata.

**Expected conclusion** (from the case definition; consumer states are computed with the reference consumer, never from a chain observation): 6 minted colors (C02 shielded, C03 unshielded, C04 shielded + unshielded = one color, C05 gold, silver) resolve to their contract, domainSep and kind with the metadata of each case; C05 bronze (never minted) is "not minted in the scanned range".

**Runs after**: C02, C03, C04, C05

- U1 (the upgrade case, run after the matrix) scans its own block range and looks up its color in its own folder (cases/U1: steps index and lookup), so this scan stays the matrix's range.
- The index state lands in {out}/index/index-state.json (deployments/preview/cases/IDX/index/ on Preview).

## Steps (Preview)

Running the steps writes the run record (`record.json`, rendered as the transaction table below) and the observations (`observed-*.json`, `wallet-status.json`). Shell set-up (bash or zsh; the secret directory holds `preview-wallet-1.mnemonic` and `preview-wallet-2.mnemonic` and is mounted read-only into the signer container only):

```sh
signer() {
  MIP0018_SECRET_DIR="<0700 directory holding the wallet mnemonics (0600)>" \
  MIP0018_STATE_DIR="<0700 state directory outside the repository>" \
  MIP0018_DOCKER_NETWORK="<Docker network of the proof server>" \
  MIP0018_DOCKER_ENV="-e MIP0018_PROOF_SERVER_URL=<proof server URL on that network>" \
  docker/signer.sh mip0018 -- "$@"
}
wallet_free() { docker/run.sh mip0018 -- "$@"; }
```

|---|---|---|---|---|
